# codebase-t3code-fork

Fork of t3-style code surface. Archive.

## Stack & contents

Filtered TypeScript snapshot of a t3code fork. ~558 files organized around chat/agent/workspace concepts. Extensive `.docs/` and 18+ numbered `.plans/` (shared model normalization through claude-agent integration).

## Why this is here

Donor of **provider-neutral, effect-based runtime** thinking. Read `.plans/01-shared-model-normalization.md` when designing the harness/driver normalization layer.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-t3code-fork:code/t3code-fork/.docs/architecture.md
git show origin/codebase-t3code-fork:code/t3code-fork/.plans/01-shared-model-normalization.md
git show origin/codebase-t3code-fork:code/t3code-fork/.plans/17-claude-agent.md
```

## Doctrine extracted (2026-04-22)

Carries forward (principles, not code):
- **Single ordered push bus + readiness gate** — UI/transport consumes only typed push events; welcome is held until startup barriers are satisfied (`.docs/architecture.md` "Startup and client connect" — `ServerReadiness + ServerPushBus`).
- **Receipt-driven async** — async work runs as queue-backed workers that emit typed completion receipts; downstream code (including tests) waits on receipts instead of polling state (`.docs/architecture.md` "Async completion flow" — `DrainableWorker + RuntimeReceiptBus`).
- **Shared cross-surface contracts** — model lists, normalization, defaults live in one shared contracts module so daemon and clients cannot drift; provider-specific knobs live in a typed `providerOptions` namespace; resume state is opaque to the orchestrator (`.plans/01-shared-model-normalization.md`; `.plans/17-claude-agent.md` §1.3, §2.2).
- **Schema-validated boundaries** — every IPC/transport entrypoint parses unknown payloads with a schema at the boundary; no internal cast may stand in for validation (`.plans/02-typed-ipc-boundaries.md`).

Leaves behind (residue):
- The specific Node WebSocket + `codex-app-server` JSON-RPC stdio topology and the Electron main/preload split.
- Anthropic Agent SDK option surface (`canUseTool`, `maxThinkingTokens`, `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable`) (`.plans/17-claude-agent.md` §2.1.a).

Topic relevance: `transport`, `orchestration`, `driver`, `recovery`, `doctrine`, `identity`, `placement`.
